name: Kuzmichev
desc: The meticulous owner of "Kuznets". As a weapons enthusiast and stickler for detail, he's confident that no one can find any weapons better than his in all of Snezhnograd.

value.name: Mystic Enhancement Ore
value.desc:
Weapon EXP material. Gives 10,000 EXP.
Legend has it that this refined ingot contains the memories of battles that had taken place in the land. The weapons that benefit from these memories naturally become sentient.

customize.name: Diagram: Emberwell
customize.desc: A blueprint recreated by Kuzmichev based on records of old legends. Learn it and you can restore Emberwell (Sword).

customize.name: Red Beet
customize.desc: A hardy herbaceous plant capable of thriving even in frozen soil. To survive such an unforgiving environment, it develops a thick, succulent root.

customize.name: Rimecurrant
customize.desc: A richly flavored berry that sprouts from frost-rimed, icy branches.

customize.name: Rainbowdrop Crystal
customize.desc:
A crystal that gives off an iridescent glow. Exceptionally tough and malleable, it has been regarded by Snezhnayan craftspeople as the best forging material since ancient times.
It is believed that when the moon's chariot was shattered, its blood-stained axle-tip fell into the earthly realm beneath the moon, transforming into an iridescent crystal. From that day on, the people of this land no longer worshipped the dead gods. The survivors who knew what the monarchs of the night died for, however, still futilely sing those long-forgotten names.

customize.name: Diagram: Covenant of Frost and Snow
customize.desc: A blueprint recreated by Kuzmichev based on records of old legends. Learn it and you can restore Covenant of Frost and Snow (Bow).

customize.name: Glaciafruit
customize.desc: A star-shaped fruit born from Prime Ice that has undergone a peculiar transformation in the permafrost. Once the branch it grows upon is removed, the fruit falls naturally onto the snow.

customize.name: Snowball Flower
customize.desc: A charming flower with a spherical cluster of petals. When snow settles upon it, the entire bloom looks just like a tiny snowball.
